contracts_checked: Original cases and their rejection/positive assertions are retained. New equi-key, left-residual and correlated-capture shapes append after the original case index range.

IdentitySource checks an actual StablePickle map definition and its single direct Member input. CheckMember compares the Member row argument by expression-node pointer with that same TExpression lambda argument, then checks the expected IU.

Each reconstructed key resolves to a unique expected primary source and the exact secondary-port rename. Complete expected-source coverage is required. Nullable encoding must occur on both sides only for the designated nullable source; reconstruction EqualNulls must remain false.

The inner join must retain the original right operator, preserve every original equi-key pair and EqualNulls value, and carry no residual filter. The domain aggregate must be directly on the secondary port, while the original bag remains on the primary port.
The rewritten residual checks precise direct inputs and lambda Member bindings, including preservation of right-side IDs and renaming only the intended left-side ID.

The correlated subplan checks the original plan pointer, EXPR kind, call result binding, empty tuple, updated external dependencies, unchanged local IDs, preserved local expression-node identity and its local inputs. RebindInputs/RebindCaptures modify outer capture references and preserve local expression nodes in production.

Borrowed pointers/references remain owned by rewritten or capturedPlan intrusive pointers throughout the checks. GetLambda returns the existing Node, so direct row-argument pointer comparison is valid; no temporary lambda copy invalidates it.

The external projection preserves the full ordered ID/label entries and output membership. Original left/right output availability and Semi/Only right-output exclusion are checked; the zero-column projection checks expected arity.
TOpRoot, TJoinIUs.Contains, TOrderedIUs equality, TDependencyIUs accessors and TExpression APIs used by the added generator match the pinned C31 production signatures.

Only the C31 generator/profile are amended. The profile retains linked_production_local_contracts, exact revision/base, generator/rendered-source hashes and byte count. C47 and SQL/quality admission rules are unchanged.
limitations: No generated C++ or SQL was rendered, printed, saved, compiled or executed in this independent review. The authored generated-source hash/byte count will be enforced again by render_suite during actual anonymous execution.

These checks prove local logical-IR binding contracts only after actual linked native success. They do not prove SQL multiplicity, execution semantics of EqualNulls, physical sharing, aggregate-to-identity value lineage or sharing expansion.
Projection checks cover the local root wrapper and output availability; they do not execute full pipeline/export behavior or cover repeated external projection IDs.
Nested subplans, additional capture families and unsupported identity types remain outside these nine added profiles. Existing explicit scope limits remain required.
